---
title: "Data Loading & Preprocessing"
---

This chapter loads raw segmentation outputs, applies the necessary
preprocessing steps, and saves processed `SpatialData` objects to zarr.
Subsequent chapters read from these processed files directly.

```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")

import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import yaml
import spatialdata as sd
import spatialdata_io
from pathlib import Path
from utils.helpers import (
    load_params,
    read_geojson_gz,
    add_proseg_zlayers,
    align_to_xenium,
    init_segtraq_objects,
    filter_transcripts,
)

with open("_params.yml") as f:
    params = yaml.safe_load(f)

processed_xenium_path = Path(params["processed_xenium_path"])
processed_proseg_path = Path(params["processed_proseg_path"])
processed_xenium_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
processed_proseg_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

## Xenium

```{python}
xenium_path = Path(params["xenium_path"])

sdata_xenium = spatialdata_io.xenium(
    xenium_path,
    cells_as_circles=False,
    cells_labels=False,
    nucleus_labels=False,
    morphology_mip=False,
)

# Link table to cell boundaries
sdata_xenium.tables["table"].obs["region"] = "cell_boundaries"
sdata_xenium.tables["table"].obs["region"] = (
    sdata_xenium.tables["table"].obs["region"].astype("category")
)
sdata_xenium.set_table_annotates_spatialelement("table", region="cell_boundaries")

# Inspect without triggering __repr__
print('Keys images:', list(sdata_xenium.images.keys()))
print('Keys shapes:', list(sdata_xenium.shapes.keys()))
print('Keys points:', list(sdata_xenium.points.keys()))
print('N cells:', sdata_xenium.tables['table'].n_obs)
```

## Proseg v3

```{python}
import spatialdata as sd
proseg_path = Path(params["proseg_path"])

# Read SpatialData zarr output from Proseg v3
sdata_proseg3 = sd.read_zarr(proseg_path / "proseg-output.zarr")

# Rename transcript columns: use observed (raw) positions, not repositioned
pts = sdata_proseg3.points["transcripts"]
pts = pts.rename(columns={
    "x": "repositioned_x",
    "y": "repositioned_y",
    "z": "repositioned_z",
    "observed_x": "x",
    "observed_y": "y",
    "observed_z": "z",
})
pts["gene"] = pts["gene"].astype("category")
sdata_proseg3.points["transcripts"] = sd.models.PointsModel.parse(pts, sort=True)

# Fix cell_boundaries index to align with table instance_key
sdata_proseg3.shapes["cell_boundaries"].set_index("cell", drop=True, inplace=True)

# Add per-z-layer boundaries
sdata_proseg3 = add_proseg_zlayers(sdata_proseg3, proseg_path)

# Align image, nucleus boundaries and transformations to Xenium
sdata_proseg3 = align_to_xenium(sdata_proseg3, sdata_xenium, has_zlayers=True)

# Inspect without triggering __repr__
print('Keys images:', list(sdata_proseg3.images.keys()))
print('Keys shapes:', list(sdata_proseg3.shapes.keys()))
print('Keys points:', list(sdata_proseg3.points.keys()))
print('N cells:', sdata_proseg3.tables['table'].n_obs)
```

## Filter transcripts

```{python}
# Initialize SegTraQ objects to apply filtering
st_dict = init_segtraq_objects(sdata_xenium, sdata_proseg3)
st_dict = filter_transcripts(st_dict, params)
```

## Save processed data

```{python}
# Overwrite if already exists
import shutil

for path in [processed_xenium_path, processed_proseg_path]:
    if path.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(path)
        print(f"Removed existing: {path}")

sdata_xenium.write(str(processed_xenium_path))
print(f"Xenium saved → {processed_xenium_path}")

sdata_proseg3.write(str(processed_proseg_path))
print(f"Proseg v3 saved → {processed_proseg_path}")
```

## Summary

```{python}
import pandas as pd

rows = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():

        "Method": method,
        "# Cells": st.sdata.tables["table"].n_obs,

pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("Method")
```
